tasks.label: Focura: cek semua (pub get + analyze + test)
tasks.command: flutter --version > _logs\version.txt 2>&1 & flutter pub get > _logs\pub.txt 2>&1 & flutter analyze > _logs\analyze.txt 2>&1 & flutter test > _logs\test.txt 2>&1 & echo SELESAI > _logs\done.txt

tasks.label: Focura: analyze + test saja
tasks.command: del /q _logs\done.txt 2>nul & flutter analyze > _logs\analyze.txt 2>&1 & flutter test > _logs\test.txt 2>&1 & echo SELESAI > _logs\done.txt

tasks.label: Focura: flutter doctor + devices
tasks.command: flutter doctor -v > _logs\doctor.txt 2>&1 & flutter devices > _logs\devices.txt 2>&1 & echo SELESAI > _logs\doctor_done.txt

tasks.label: Focura: cek koneksi ke server Google (untuk build APK)
tasks.command: (nslookup dl.google.com & nslookup dl.google.com 8.8.8.8 & curl -sS -I https://dl.google.com/dl/android/maven2/index.html) > _logs\network.txt 2>&1 & echo SELESAI > _logs\network_done.txt

tasks.label: Focura: bagikan ke HP/laptop lain (Wi-Fi sama, port 8090)
Focura: cek git
tasks.command: (git --version & where gh & git config --global user.name & git config --global user.email & git config --global credential.helper & git status) > _logs\git.txt 2>&1 & echo SELESAI > _logs\git_done.txt

tasks.label: Focura: git commit pertama
tasks.command: (git init -b main & git add -A & git commit -m "Focura: aplikasi Pomodoro (auth, CRUD tugas, API, notifikasi, musik, terjemahan)" -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" -m "Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_013mNVAqEcbUq1vqsPv4Xa6m" & git log --oneline -3 & git count-objects -vH & git ls-files) > _logs\git_commit.txt 2>&1 & echo SELESAI > _logs\git_commit_done.txt

tasks.label: Focura: push ke GitHub
tasks.command: git remote remove origin 2>$null; git remote add origin https://github.com/rosyidmuzakiputro65/focura-pomodoro.git; git push -u origin main 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath _logs\push.txt; git remote -v | Out-File -Append _logs\push.txt; 'SELESAI' | Out-File _logs\push_done.txt

tasks.label: Focura: cek alat Firebase
tasks.command: (echo NODE & node -v & echo NPM & npm -v & echo FIREBASE & firebase --version & echo DART & dart --version & echo FLUTTERFIRE & flutterfire --version & echo PUBCACHE & dir %LOCALAPPDATA%\Pub\Cache\bin) > _logs\fbtools.txt 2>&1 & echo SELESAI > _logs\fbtools_done.txt

tasks.label: Focura: commit & push pembaruan
tasks.command: git add -A; git commit -m 'Integrasi Firebase Authentication & Cloud Firestore, musik fokus, terjemahan kutipan' -m 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>' -m 'Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_013mNVAqEcbUq1vqsPv4Xa6m' 2>&1 | Out-File _logs\push2.txt; git push 2>&1 | Out-File -Append _logs\push2.txt; git status --short | Out-File -Append _logs\push2.txt; git log --oneline -3 | Out-File -Append _logs\push2.txt; 'SELESAI' | Out-File _logs\push2_done.txt

tasks.label: Focura: ambil SHA-1/SHA-256 (debug keystore)
tasks.command: $out='_logs\sha.txt'; $cfg = flutter config --list 2>&1 | Out-String; $jdk = ($cfg -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match 'jdk-dir:\s*(.+)$' } | ForEach-Object { $Matches[1].Trim() }) | Select-Object -First 1; $cands = @(); if ($jdk) { $cands += (Join-Path $jdk 'bin\keytool.exe') }; $cands += @('C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr\bin\keytool.exe','C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jre\bin\keytool.exe'); $kt = $cands | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $kt) { $kt = (Get-ChildItem -Path 'C:\Program Files','C:\Program Files (x86)',"$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs","$env:USERPROFILE\.gradle","$env:USERPROFILE\.jdks",'D:\' -Filter keytool.exe -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).FullName }; "CONFIG:`n$cfg`nKEYTOOL: $kt" | Out-File $out; if ($kt) { & $kt -list -v -keystore "$env:USERPROFILE\.android\debug.keystore" -alias androiddebugkey -storepass android -keypass android 2>&1 | Out-File -Append $out }; 'SELESAI' | Out-File _logs\sha_done.txt

tasks.label: Focura: push README
tasks.command: git add README.md .vscode/tasks.json; git commit -m 'Perbarui README sesuai fitur terbaru (Firebase, login Google, link web)' -m 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>' -m 'Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_013mNVAqEcbUq1vqsPv4Xa6m' 2>&1 | Out-File _logs\deploy.txt; git push 2>&1 | Out-File -Append _logs\deploy.txt; 'SELESAI' | Out-File _logs\deploy_done.txt
